title: Compress Video - Resize Video
summary: Compress videos to smaller file sizes for email & WhatsApp - no quality loss
description:
Compress Video - the fastest way to shrink videos while keeping them looking great.

Video too big to email, upload, or send on WhatsApp? Compress Video turns gigabytes into megabytes in a few taps - and lets you preview the real result, so you know exactly how it will look and how much space it will take before processing the whole video.

📉 THREE WAYS TO COMPRESS
- Quick Compress: pick a quality level and go - the app optimizes your video to save the most space while looking as good as possible.
- Target file size: one-tap presets for Gmail (25 MB), WhatsApp (16 MB) and Outlook (10 MB) attachment limits, or enter the exact size in MB and the app hits it for you.
- Target resolution: pick 144p, 240p, 360p, 480p, 720p or 1080p, and the video is resized to match.

👀 REAL PREVIEW - SEE BEFORE YOU COMPRESS
The app compresses a short snippet of your video with your exact settings, so you can watch the actual result and check the estimated file size before committing.

🗂️ BATCH COMPRESSION
Select multiple videos and compress them all at once - perfect for freeing up space after a trip or an event.

✂️ TRIM & MUTE
Cut your video down to just the part you need, and optionally remove the audio track for even smaller files.

🔒 PRIVATE & OFFLINE
Your videos are processed entirely on your device - nothing is ever uploaded.

🎞️ ANY VIDEO IN, MP4 OUT
Works with MP4, MOV, MKV, 3GP and all common formats - compressed videos are saved as universally compatible MP4.

PERFECT FOR:
📧 Emailing videos with attachment size limits
💬 Sending videos on WhatsApp, Discord, Telegram & Messenger
📱 Freeing up storage on your phone
🌐 Faster uploads to social media

Simple, fast, and free. Download Compress Video and shrink your first video in seconds.
